remarks: Welcome to the highly sought-after Bettswood neighborhood, where this delightful corner-lot gem awaits! Step inside to discover four spacious bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms, all graced with gleaming hardwood floors that flow seamlessly throughout the home. Bursting with character, every room offers its own unique charm.  Enjoy peace of mind and privacy in your fully fenced yard-perfect for pets, play, or garden parties. The two-car garage keeps your vehicles cozy, while the inviting covered porch is just begging for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Recent updates mean you can move right in and start making memories!  Location? It couldn't be better! Stroll over to Stew Leonard's for fresh groceries, or hop in the car and you're just minutes from major highways, shopping hotspots, and sun-soaked beaches. This is more than a house-it's your next happy chapter!
